notes: Dark-mode rewrote all of Gauge.tsx (per-scheme GAUGE_COLORS, a scheme prop, a header-row layout, an alert-tinted track, and its own table-driven formatting), and the refactor moved the gauge's logic into useGauge(). The resolution splits along that line: the presentation is dark-mode's (GAUGE_COLORS stays exported for its tests, plus the scheme prop, layout and alertTrack), and the logic comes from the refactor's hook. Dark-mode's inline SCALES table is dropped, because the logic now lives in the hook, so formatting is the hook's (identical for every current reading; metric flow above 999 m³/s stays ungrouped).
